quotes.text: Small consistent honesty beats grand occasional inspiration.
The world owes you nothing, which means everything it gives is a gift.
The scariest ideas are usually the truest ones. Chase those.
The best time to build trust was before you needed it. The second best time is now.
Correct the mistake, protect the person.
Perfectionism is fear wearing a nice outfit.
Momentum is a leadership deliverable.
Adversity is the tuition of wisdom. Pay it without resentment.
Leadership is the art of making other people's success feel inevitable.
You cannot control the wind, but the set of your sail is entirely yours.
The good life is not found. It is practiced.
Praise loudly. Correct quietly. Learn constantly.
Creativity isn't a tank you empty. It's a muscle that strengthens with use.
Wonder is a discipline. Practice it daily.
Make bad art on purpose sometimes. It loosens the hinges.
The map matters less than the trust of the people walking with you.
Originality is just honesty that hasn't been diluted yet.
Decide slowly on people, quickly on process.
Great leaders are thermostat, not thermometer — they set the temperature.
Doubt is part of the process, not a verdict on the work.
Change is the universe's only promise. Make peace with it early.
Creativity thrives on 'yes, and' — starve it with 'yes, but' at your peril.
Listening is the only leadership skill that works on the first day and the last.
The hardest part of leading is going first when no one claps.
Every act of creation starts by risking looking foolish.
Leaders don't create pressure. They convert it into direction.
If you want to know what a leader values, watch what they tolerate.
Let go of the applause. It was never yours to keep.
An untrained mind treats every ripple as a tsunami.
Lead the person in front of you, not the version of them you wish existed.
A clenched fist can hold nothing new.
Every dawn is a small resurrection. Act like it.
Every expert was once a beginner who kept embarrassing themselves.
Do not explain your philosophy. Embody it.
Don't build followers. Build people who don't need you.
Constraints aren't the enemy of creativity. They're the trellis it climbs.
The present moment is the only battlefield. Win here.
Give your ideas a deadline or they'll live rent-free forever.
What stands in the way of your character? Nothing you didn't put there.
Practice losing small things gracefully, so you can lose large things without breaking.
Every masterpiece began as someone's mess.
The team doesn't rise to the vision. It rises to the standard.
Curiosity is creativity's oxygen supply.
Build the bench before you need it, and you'll never lead from fear.
A strong mind holds opinions loosely and principles firmly.
An artist's job is to notice what everyone sees and say what no one has.
Simplicity is the final sophistication of a disciplined soul.
You can't pour confidence into a team you keep interrupting.
Quantity is the fastest road to quality. Make more, judge later.
Break your own patterns before the boredom breaks you.
